assessments.reasoning: The startup-file section singles out command names for case and punctuation equivalence and provides three spellings of one command, distinct from its string parameter. The same archive's version file identifies GNU Wget 1.25.0.

challenge.method: Separate each publisher example's name from its value at the assignment delimiter. Compare the three name spellings after case-folding and removal of the two documented separator characters. Inspect the parameter declaration separately.
challenge.results: All three names reduce to dirprefix. The documented parameter is a string and the examples establish name equivalence without establishing any corresponding transformation of value text, path or shell syntax.

limitations: Describes Wget 1.25.0's documented startup-file command-name rule. Actual command execution, additional punctuation, values and command-line syntax were not evaluated.
